description: VIM Master: in-browser game that teaches core Vim motions and editing commands through short, focused levels.

summary.one_liner: VIM Master is a browser-based game that teaches Vim motions and editing commands through short, focused levels.
summary.what_it_does: The game runs in a simulated editor inside the browser, where players practice Vim commands through short lessons with progressive difficulty. Progress is gamified with XP, combos, achievements and badges. Each lesson is a standalone JSON file in content/lessons, and a build step compiles them into content/index.json for the engine to read. A Practice Arena offers time-limited speed and accuracy challenges, and a Cheat Mode provides a command reference. Progress, badges and XP are saved locally and can be imported or exported. The README describes a test suite covering lesson schemas, end-to-end replay of each lesson's solution keypresses, save regression, and unit logic.
use_cases: practice vim motions in the browser
teach vim to beginners with a game
study vim editing commands before a project
add custom vim lessons as JSON
notable: Content platform architecture: each lesson is one JSON file, so new lessons need no engine changes
Golden test suite replays each lesson's solution keypresses through the real engine
Gamification with XP, combos, achievements and badges
Local save with import and export of progress
caveats: Roadmap lists V3 UX polish and a public beta as still in progress
